subject: Taxes
title: The Mortgage Interest Deduction
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Mortgage Interest Deduction.

hook.text: Homeowners can deduct mortgage interest on loans up to $750,000.

buildup.text: The deduction was meant to promote homeownership. It saves billions for homeowners who itemize their taxes.

discovery.text: Most of the benefit goes to high-income homeowners with large mortgages. Low-income renters get nothing.

twist.text: Economists argue the deduction raises home prices rather than helping buyers.

climax.text: The mortgage deduction is a $25 billion annual subsidy that mostly benefits the wealthy.

punchline.text: $25 billion for homeowners. Renters get zero. Politically untouchable.

quiz.question: Who benefits most from the mortgage interest deduction?
